description: Shipping courier visibility, live rate quotes, and label generation. list_couriers shows which shipping plugins (shipping-custom, DHL Express, Aramex, Uber Direct, Bolt Send, Pargo, The Courier Guy, CouriIt) are enabled/configured — use manage_plugins to turn one on or set non-secret fields; secrets (API keys, passwords) must be set in the seller dashboard. quote returns live rate quotes from every enabled courier for a destination — Bolt Send and Pargo return a "confirm at pickup/selection" placeholder price (no live rate API), and this endpoint never quotes DHL/Aramex (label-only carriers, see below). generate_label creates a REAL shipment + waybill via the courier API and only works for DHL Express and Aramex (the only couriers with label generation implemented) — it writes tracking info to the order and marks it label_generated/shipped. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: Uber Direct, The Courier Guy, and CouriIt support quoting only — there is no booking/dispatch/pickup-creation step for them anywhere in this system; do not tell a user their parcel has been booked or a driver dispatched for these three couriers, only that a rate quote was retrieved.

carrier.description: generate_label: which carrier to use — required for generate_label

orderId.description: generate_label: order to ship — required for generate_label

subtotal.description: quote: order subtotal, used for free-shipping threshold

toPostal.description: quote: destination postal code (needed for The Courier Guy / CouriIt)

weightGrams.description: quote: parcel weight in grams, default 500

name: manage_shipping
